cases.notes: Photo itself is clean and well-lit — the defect is print size, not capture quality. CP-2 §9.2 finding 1 (docs/checkpoints/cp2-warning-subsystem.md): WarningComparatorResult can only return LOW_IMAGE_QUALITY, WARNING_MISMATCH, or MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD, never LOW_MODEL_CONFIDENCE. Fixed by TRO-469 / LH-021; the prior expected.reviewReason (LOW_MODEL_CONFIDENCE) was a value this field can never actually carry. TRO-469 predicted LOW_IMAGE_QUALITY as the replacement value, reasoning tiny print reaching this comparator would route there by default. TRO-535 (2026-08-12) swept OCR_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR from 60 to 50 and let the OCR channel's real reading reach the reconciler. Measured, live (eval-report.json, measuredAt 2026-08-12T22:15:52.776Z): the OCR channel now reads this print at distance 47 from the statute, the two channels disagree, and the comparator returns WARNING_MISMATCH — one of the same three legal values CP-2 §9.2 finding 1 already named, just not the one TRO-469 predicted. TRO-516 (correction C4) corrects expected.reviewReason to match this measured result.
